'''Ooze''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Star Wars: Imperial Assault Core Set" />

==Behind the scenes==
'''Ooze''' was introduced in the starter set of the [[Fantasy Flight Games]] tactical miniatures [[roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars: Imperial Assault]]''.
